# Membrane MPEG.TS Plugin v2.4.9 - Table of Contents

MPEG-TS Demuxer that implements the Membrane.Filter behaviour.

## Modules

- [Membrane.MPEG.TS.Demuxer](https://membrane-mpeg-ts-plugin.hexdocs.pm/Membrane.MPEG.TS.Demuxer.md): Demuxes MPEG TS stream.
- [Membrane.MPEG.TS.Muxer](https://membrane-mpeg-ts-plugin.hexdocs.pm/Membrane.MPEG.TS.Muxer.md): Experimental MPEG-TS Muxer. Supports 1 program with AAC and H264 in it only for now.
- [Membrane.MPEG.TS.OpusPayload](https://membrane-mpeg-ts-plugin.hexdocs.pm/Membrane.MPEG.TS.OpusPayload.md): Packetizes and depacketizes Opus for MPEG-TS payloads.

- [Membrane.MPEG.TS.Profiles](https://membrane-mpeg-ts-plugin.hexdocs.pm/Membrane.MPEG.TS.Profiles.md): Well-known stream profiles that combine stream_type, descriptors, and payload adapters.
- [Membrane.MPEG.TS.StreamFormat](https://membrane-mpeg-ts-plugin.hexdocs.pm/Membrane.MPEG.TS.StreamFormat.md): MPEG-TS stream format derived from PMT entries.

- Exceptions
  - [Membrane.MPEG.TS.Muxer.CorruptionError](https://membrane-mpeg-ts-plugin.hexdocs.pm/Membrane.MPEG.TS.Muxer.CorruptionError.md): Error raised when the muxer produces corrupted output.
